request.subject: PORTRAIT:CANDY:BATTLESHIP

layers.text: Recolour as a chocolate cake galleon and change no shape: the pale hull becomes layers of dark chocolate sponge #4a2412 with thin cream stripes and a caramel gold #e0a040 rim in place of the pink frosting; the sails stay cream white; the masts and pennants become caramel gold #e0a040. No pink is left. Keep every shape, thick black outline and style the same, on a transparent background.
